title: It did make my shitty life better #kimberlyakimbo #broadway #theatre ...
transcript: so I did finally go see Kimberly Kimbo Broadway edition. I was saving this one because I figured of all the new musicals, it was the least likely to close early, and it turns out I was kind of right, sadly. I thought this musical was really charming off Broadway, and I think it is just as charming on Broadway. this is just absolutely spectacular. I still think Victoria Clark is by and large the front runner for best leading actress at this point in time. and if you've never gotten to see Bonnie Milli get on on stage, what are you doing? she is a freaking star and hilarious in this. seriously though, every single performance in this is absolutely amazing. the entire cast is perfect. the show itself is written by David Lindsey, A bear and Janine To. Sorry, who worked with each other before on Shrek. and I love Shrek, but I would say that this is less like Shrek and more like their other works that they've done separately. if you are familiar with David Lindsey of Bears plays, this is very much in the realm of that. of course, because it started off as one of his plays, but it also feels like his brand of humor that's wacky and weird, but it has, like, this dark undertone to it. if you are familiar with funny mirrors or wonder of the world, kind of in the same vein as that, jeanine Tesori is a composer. where I truly feel like all of her work is so vastly wonderful and different. but for me this fits more into the vein of A Fun Home in terms of sound. so if you are a fan of the music and Fun Home, especially the upbeat numbers, you are definitely going to enjoy this. just based off the music alone. overall though, I just really love this show. it's a show that is wacky and weird, but also just warms your heart. and it does. it makes your shitty life better. personally, this is still my front runner for best new musical. I think the closest that any other shows gonna get right now is maybe Some Like It Hot, but as an overall production, this in my opinion is the strongest at this point. we'll see what the spring shows bring. this is just such a fun and sweet show, and if it's not on your list currently for your New York trip, I would consider putting it on there.
